baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ك ذ ب verbs at words 2 and 4, joined to the temporal مِن قَبْلِهِمْ at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: The conditional present denial is answered by an already completed denial among predecessors. The repeated root makes denial a socially transmitted verdict imposed on message-bearers, while the temporal construction makes the present event another occurrence of an older relation rather than an isolated insult.

activation_trace.role: The branch makes denial an act of imputing falsehood to someone or something, supplying the repeated social verdict in the mechanism.
The branch supplies temporal precedence and turns the earlier deniers into the antecedent instance of the present event.
The branch joins a carried message to its bearer, identifying the persons upon whom the verdict of falsehood falls.

changed_reading.before: The verse says only that earlier people also rejected prophets.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages denial as a recurring act of assigning falsehood to message-bearers, placing the current audience inside an inherited relation of refusal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم at words 8-9 followed by three coordinated بِ-phrases.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival and messengerhood form a delivery event: bearers come to their own people carrying a payload through several channels. The plural messengers and the repeated instrumental preposition make the ayah dynamic, emphasizing conveyance and presentation rather than the static existence of evidence.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes bringing and making something present, giving the messengers' arrival the function of evidence delivery.
The branch supplies both carried communication and its bearer, coupling persons to the payload they present.
The branch contributes successive groups, making the plural messengers a repeatable delivery stream rather than one isolated arrival.
The branch supplies disclosure through speech, writing, or sign, defining the first carried item by its communicative work.

changed_reading.before: Messengers existed and possessed proofs and books.
changed_reading.after: Messengers repeatedly arrived as carriers who made a multi-channel evidentiary payload present to their own communities.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ at words 10-13.
baseline_models.mechanism: The three coordinated terms can function as a differentiated evidentiary architecture: disclosure makes a matter perceptible, inscription preserves it, assembly gives it ordered and possibly binding form, and illumination makes that order navigable. This preserves the ordinary readings of signs and writings while resisting collapse of all three nouns into synonyms.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes emergence into visibility, assigning the first channel the work of disclosure.
The branch contributes inscription and written records, assigning the second channel durable textual preservation.
The branch contributes joining separate parts, making the singular book an ordered assembly rather than a loose collection.
The branch contributes fixed judgment or determination, leaving a live legally binding reading alongside the written-object reading.
The branch contributes emitted light, making disclosure an active property of the book.
The branch contributes a visible route marker, assigning illumination the practical work of orientation.

changed_reading.before: Clear proofs, scriptures, and an illuminating book are three labels for the same religious evidence.
changed_reading.after: The coordinated nouns retain distinct affordances: showing, preserving, assembling or binding, and orienting can cooperate without becoming one undifferentiated category.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-duplicate at 35:4 first presents earlier messengers as the grammatical patients of denial; 35:25 names the earlier deniers and only then recounts what their own messengers delivered. The echo revises historical recurrence into an agency audit: the later formulation restores the rejecting communities as actors in the face of supplied evidence.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes attribution of falsehood, while the passive earlier occurrence foregrounds the recipients of that attribution.
The branch identifies message-bearers as the earlier objects of denial, providing the role later reframed through named deniers.
The branch establishes the earlier temporal instance that 35:25 expands into an evidentiary case.
The same attribution branch now links current deniers directly to the explicitly named earlier agents.

structural_cues: 35:4 and 35:25 share the conditional opening, repeated denial root, messengers, and temporal precedence.
The earlier verse passivizes the denial of prior messengers; the focus verse names prior deniers before listing what reached them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the verbal echo and agency shift; I infer that the later expansion reallocates responsibility by adding the delivered evidence. Alternatively, the repetition may serve consolation without a deliberate forensic progression.

changed_reading.before: The historical parallel mainly consoles the addressed messenger.
changed_reading.after: The parallel also audits agency: communities are named as deniers after delivery, so precedent intensifies rather than diffuses their responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 35:9 sending initiates a transport sequence: wind is released, cloud is stirred and driven, and dead land is revived. Because the focus ayah also joins messenger-dispatch, arrival, and carried material, that sequence activates an ecological analogy in which evidence moves through carriers toward potentially unresponsive ground.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally spans released winds and dispatched messengers, furnishing the shared initiating motion for the analogy.
The branch contributes moving air, giving the dispatched carrier a material transport image.
The branch contributes displacement and stirring, supplying the first transfer from carrier to payload.
The branch contributes directed driving, turning movement into delivery toward a destination.
The branch contributes land made alive through rain and growth, supplying the possible effect of a successfully received delivery.
The branch anchors the analogy in the focus ayah by making arrival an act of bringing a payload.
The branch keeps the focus messengers within the broader release-and-dispatch image without reducing persons to weather.

structural_cues: 35:9 supplies an ordered send-stir-drive-revive chain; 35:25 supplies an arrive-with-evidence chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two delivery sequences sharing the dispatch root; I infer an analogy from material transport to evidentiary transport. Alternatively, 35:9 may orient only resurrection imagery and have no bearing on messenger delivery.

changed_reading.before: Human envoys simply brought propositions to earlier peoples.
changed_reading.after: Their coming can also be pictured as a release-and-transport ecology in which carriers set life-giving evidence in motion, while reception by the destination remains contingent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly preserves difference within common provenance: two seas are not equivalent though both yield benefits, and one descent of water produces divergent fruits, mountain bands, and colors. These patterns strengthen the focus-only reading that signs, records, and the illuminating book are coordinated but non-identical evidentiary media.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes explicit non-equivalence between two productive media, modeling cooperation without synonymy.
The branch contributes divergence into different paths, giving common-source products distinct trajectories.
The branch contributes distinct kinds, turning visible colors into a cue for categorical differentiation.
The branch anchors one medium in making what was hidden visibly distinct.
The branch anchors a second medium in inscription and preserved records.
The branch anchors the final modifier in visible orientation rather than mere repetition of proof.

structural_cues: The focus uses three separately prepositioned coordinated nouns rather than one noun with three modifiers.
35:12 and 35:27-28 juxtapose common benefit or source with preserved differences of medium, product, and kind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring common-source diversity; I infer that the focus list likewise distributes evidentiary functions across distinct forms. Alternatively, the list may be cumulative emphasis with substantial referential overlap.

changed_reading.before: The three evidence terms intensify one generic claim of proof.
changed_reading.after: The terms can mark non-equivalent channels whose different affordances cooperate: manifestation, archival inscription, ordered authority, and orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in separates successful dispatch from successful uptake: the addressed messenger warns, is sent with stable truth, and belongs to a warning pattern reaching every community, yet cannot make all hear in the sense of understanding or compliance. The focus ayah therefore records completed presentation of evidence, not evidence that mechanically forces assent.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes understanding and compliance beyond acoustic perception, locating the possible failure at reception rather than dispatch.
The branch contributes causing another to hear, marking the effect the human messenger cannot independently guarantee.
The branch contributes warning intended to awaken caution, defining the messenger's bounded communicative function.
The branch contributes dispatch and release, establishing that the sending side of the relation has occurred.
The branch contributes stable correspondence with reality, separating the payload's truth from the audience's response.
The repeated warning branch universalizes the communicative role immediately before the focus recounts denial.
The branch anchors the revised reading in actual arrival, a completed event that does not itself encode acceptance.

structural_cues: 35:22 denies the addressee control over hearing; 35:23 limits his stated role to warning; 35:24 affirms sending with truth and a warner in every community; 35:25 then recounts denial despite arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies role, dispatch, truth, and failed-hearing clauses; I infer a delivery-versus-uptake distinction. Alternatively, the hearing contrast may concern only a fixed class likened to the dead, not a general model of reception.

changed_reading.before: The clear evidence is expected to compel any audience that encounters it.
changed_reading.after: The ayah certifies that truthful warning and evidence arrived while leaving uptake non-mechanical; denial can persist after the delivery relation is complete.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, the book is recited, identified as revealed truth that confirms what precedes it, and transferred as inherited knowledge to a selected but internally varied community. This revises the evidence from a once-delivered archive into a relay whose arrival continues through voiced sequence, confirmation, and inheritance.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes one sound following another, giving the written book an ongoing voiced mode of transmission.
The branch contributes the written object being voiced, connecting inscription to active recitation.
The branch contributes divinely sourced communication, establishing the relay's originating provenance.
The branch contributes completed soundness and stability, making confirmation a continuity test rather than bare repetition.
The branch explicitly contributes transfer of knowledge or book by inheritance, extending delivery across generations.
The repeated written-object branch identifies what persists through the inherited relay.
The branch anchors the relay in the focus ayah's inscribed records.
The branch makes the transmitted book a route marker whose orientation remains available to later recipients.

structural_cues: 35:29, 35:31, and 35:32 form a recite-reveal-and-confirm-inherit sequence around the repeated book noun.
The inherited community in 35:32 contains divergent responses, so transmission does not erase reception differences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, revelation, confirmation, and inheritance; I infer these as successive operations in one continuing delivery relay. Alternatively, they may be independent descriptions of the book rather than stages of transmission.

changed_reading.before: The earlier communities received completed documents in a past arrival.
changed_reading.after: Their documents belong to a living relay: inscription becomes voice, confirms antecedent transmission, and passes into inheritance without guaranteeing uniform response.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 35:40 a given book and an evidence-ground are posed as possible authorization, then contrasted with wrongdoers promising one another only unstable glitter. This opposition revises the focus list into a provenance test: genuine evidence arrives through an authorized disclosure-record-book chain, while counterfeit assurance circulates laterally among peers.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes an actual written object whose being given would ground the challenged authorization.
The branch contributes evident disclosure, defining the warrant that the rhetorical challenge withholds.
The branch contributes speech that opens expectation, furnishing the counterfeit chain's persuasive social act.
The branch contributes partitioned members acting on one another, making the false assurance circulate peer to peer.
The branch contributes deceptive shine without stability, exposing the lateral promises as counterfeit illumination.
The branch anchors the focus book in fixed authority rather than merely persuasive circulation.
The branch contributes genuine emitted light against which the unstable shine of deception can be contrasted.

structural_cues: 35:40 opposes the questioned sequence of a given book and evidence from it to mutual promises ending in deception.
The focus places disclosure, records, and the illuminating book after messenger arrival rather than peer circulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed warrant structures; I infer a provenance-and-authentication contrast between them. Alternatively, 35:40 may challenge only idolaters' specific authorization and leave the focus list as a generic historical catalogue.

changed_reading.before: The focus inventories persuasive religious materials.
changed_reading.after: It also specifies an authorized chain of custody for evidence, contrasted with self-reinforcing promises whose apparent brightness has no stable warrant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence turns the focus's historical recurrence into a trajectory. People promise readiness for a warner; actual arrival increases their flight; harmful plotting encloses its own people; the recurring way is unchanged; and travel can expose the predecessors' outcome. Denial after arrival is thus not merely repeated but shown as a self-intensifying movement toward observable recoil.

activation_trace.role: The repeated branch contributes actual arrival before and after the stated expectation, making response to presence measurable.
The branch contributes warning meant to awaken caution, sharpening the reversal when its arrival produces the opposite movement.
The branch contributes active distancing from a thing, giving denial a directional recoil away from delivered warning.
The branch contributes harm descending upon and surrounding its source, supplying the return path in the mechanism.
The branch contributes a running and followed way, converting historical recurrence into a stable trajectory.
The branch contributes directed sight or insight, making the historical trajectory empirically inspectable.
The branch contributes the terminal outcome of a process, supplying what the observer is asked to inspect.
The branch contributes temporal predecessors whose outcomes complete the focus ayah's earlier-denial pattern.
The branch anchors the trajectory in the repeated attribution of falsehood that follows evidentiary arrival.

structural_cues: 35:42 orders oath, anticipated arrival, actual arrival, and increased aversion; 35:43 adds enclosing recoil and a stable way; 35:44 directs inspection toward predecessors' outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the arrival-aversion-recoil-way-outcome sequence; I infer a causal trajectory connecting it to denial after evidence in the focus. Alternatively, the closing clauses may be separate warnings joined rhetorically rather than one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Earlier denial is a repeated fact that normalizes the present rejection.
changed_reading.after: Earlier denial is an inspectable trajectory: resisted arrival can intensify flight, feed a returning plot, and culminate in the predecessors' observable outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a dyed-garment branch of ك ذ ب rather than its primary speech sense. It remains anchored in the duplicated focus verb and is activated by beautified seeing and mutable color surfaces elsewhere in the packet; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for denial, never as the lexical translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The duplicated ك ذ ب at words 2 and 4 can carry an exploratory image of a surface that misreports its condition.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes a decorated textile whose visible condition misrepresents what it is, supplying the surface-deception analogy.
The branch contributes making something appear beautiful, providing a contextual operation that can produce a misleading surface.
The branch contributes visual or inward seeing, locating the resulting error in perception as well as speech.
The branch contributes acquiring a changed color, supplying the mutable surface feature that completes the analogy.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a spoken assertion that the messenger is false.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial can also operate by cosmetically organizing perception so that a decorated surface is taken as the true condition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form ordinarily activates written records, while the retained branch supplies rebuke and restraint. It remains anchored directly in ز ب ر and is activated by the adjacent warning and censure sequence; downstream prose should keep writings as the primary reading and describe admonitory force as a coexisting resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ز ب ر noun at word 11 has a branch in which the root checks or restrains rather than merely inscribes.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes forceful checking and restraint, giving the records a possible admonitory function.
The branch contributes warning that wakes caution, activating restraint as part of the delivered material's work.
The branch contributes a reprehensible matter met with rebuke, extending the adjacent warning into censure after denial.

changed_reading.before: The zubur are passive archived writings alongside another book.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that primary sense, they may carry the active force of records that admonish, check, and place limits before the later censure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses non-persistence and interrupted-motion branches of ك ذ ب rather than false assertion. It remains anchored in the doubled denial root and gains mechanism from the later recited, inherited book and the contrast between perishing and non-perishing courses; downstream prose should label it a temporal test of denial, not replace the ordinary meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two ك ذ ب verbs at words 2 and 4 can activate branch images in which an expected supply fails to last or motion stops after beginning.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes an expected supply that disappears instead of enduring, making persistence an exploratory truth test.
The branch contributes motion that begins and then halts, giving denial the image of an interrupted course.
The branch contributes following in sequence, supplying the contrasting continuity of recited transmission.
The branch contributes collapse and ruin, making the explicit non-collapse of the book-linked course a durability contrast.
The branch contributes intergenerational transfer of book or knowledge, showing the evidentiary relay persisting beyond one encounter.

changed_reading.before: Denial and evidence differ only as false and true propositions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they also diverge under time: denial is a course that fails or stops, while the voiced and inherited evidence continues.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads stonework, joining, and route-marking branches as a material system rather than taking the evidence nouns only as genres of revelation. It remains anchored in ز ب ر, ك ت ب, and ن و ر and is activated by contextual holding, displacement, and a stable running way; downstream prose should call it an architectural analogy for archival stability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 11-13 can be aligned as consolidation, joined order, and visible orientation within the focus's evidentiary sequence.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes stone-lined consolidation and firmness, supplying the archive's retaining structure.
The branch contributes joining separate pieces, supplying ordered structural cohesion.
The branch contributes a visible route marker, making the stable structure navigable.
The branch contributes holding and preventing release, activating preservation against displacement.
The branch contributes removal from place or condition, defining the drift that the material archive resists.
The branch contributes a continuously followed path, linking durable preservation to repeatable orientation.

changed_reading.before: The verse names several textual artifacts that contain information.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it also pictures evidence as anti-drift infrastructure: consolidated, joined, and visibly marked so a path remains recoverable.

strongest_changes: The 35:4 echo changes precedent from consolation alone into an audit that restores denying communities as agents after evidence arrived.
The 35:22-24 lead-in sharply separates completed truthful delivery from compelled hearing or compliance.
The 35:29-32 sequence turns past documents into a continuing relay of recitation, confirmation, and inheritance.
The 35:40 contrast makes the focus list an authorized evidence chain opposed to peer-circulated counterfeit assurance.
The 35:42-44 close turns repeated denial into an arrival-aversion-recoil-outcome trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah behaved less like a flat historical catalogue than a junction between delivery, reception, transmission, and provenance. Its root branches also supported contained material readings in which evidence discloses, consolidates, binds, orients, admonishes, and persists, while denial can operate through attribution, misleading surfaces, aversion, or failure to endure.
remaining_uncertainties: The evidentiary nouns may substantially overlap in reference even if their branch functions remain distinct.
The ecological dispatch model depends on analogy from the shared sending root and should not identify messengers with winds or evidence with rain.
The admonitory, surface, non-persistence, and architectural activations are branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The causal arrows from failed reception to aversion and recoil are reader-supplied syntheses of ordered contextual clauses, not grammatical entailments of 35:25 alone.
